title: Recording a button sound
passage:
F: The tutorial needs the sound that confirms a setting. I hear a click in our recording. Is that it?
M: No. That’s the button going down. The confirmation is a short tone just after you let go. You won’t hear it if the button is held down.
F: I stopped recording before I let go. I’ll do it again without talking.
M: Good. Record the whole press this time so the editor can tell the click from the tone, even though only the tone goes in the tutorial.
passageZh:
F: 教學影片需要設定完成的確認音。這次錄音裡有一聲喀嚓。是那個嗎？
M: 不是。那是按鍵被按下的聲音。放開後才會有一聲短提示音，那才是確認音。一直按著就聽不到。
F: 我還沒放開就停止錄音了。我會重錄一次，這次不說話。
M: 好。這次把按下到放開整段錄起來，讓剪輯人員分辨喀嚓聲和提示音。不過放進教學影片的只有提示音。
